collection.title: Mercedes-Benz GLA Class 2020 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz GLA Class SUV 2020 Onwards (247) requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Fit Mercedes-Benz arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this GLA Class which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
